import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { constraintShapesChild } from "./constraint_shapes_child";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "status" accepts only 'draft', 'published', 'archived' (a CHECK the database enforces); a closed set on a text column is not declared yet (`.oneOf()` there waits on `text-one-of`), so the API leaves it to the database.
//   - "tier" accepts only 'free', 'pro', 'enterprise' (a CHECK the database enforces); a closed set on a text column is not declared yet (`.oneOf()` there waits on `text-one-of`), so the API leaves it to the database.
//   - "visibility" accepts only 'public', 'private' (a CHECK the database enforces); a closed set on a text column is not declared yet (`.oneOf()` there waits on `text-one-of`), so the API leaves it to the database.
//   - "pinned_kind" accepts only 'only-one' (a CHECK the database enforces); a closed set on a text column is not declared yet (`.oneOf()` there waits on `text-one-of`), so the API leaves it to the database.
//   - "apostrophe_set" accepts only 'it's', 'won't' (a CHECK the database enforces); a closed set on a text column is not declared yet (`.oneOf()` there waits on `text-one-of`), so the API leaves it to the database.
//   - "search" is tsvector, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "computed_total" is a generated column whose expression was not read; it is declared read-only, and a push would plan it as a plain column.
export const constraintShapes = defineTable("constraint_shapes", {
    description: "Every CHECK shape the parser is expected to handle.",
    columns: {
        id: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        price: col.numeric().notNull().validate({ moreThan: 0 }).describe("Unit price, before tax."),
        discount: col.real().validate({ min: 0, max: 1 }),
        quantity: col.integer().validate({ min: 1, max: 1000 }),
        rating: col.smallint().validate({ min: 1, max: 5 }),
        temperature: col.integer().validate({ moreThan: -50, lessThan: 60 }),
        exactCount: col.integer().validate({ min: 42, max: 42 }),
        percent: col.numeric(5, 2).validate({ min: 0, max: 100 }),
        status: col.text().notNull().describe("Publication state."),
        tier: col.varchar(20),
        visibility: col.text(),
        pinnedKind: col.text(),
        apostropheSet: col.text(),
        code: col.text().validate({ max: 10 }),
        slug: col.text().validate({ min: 3, max: 64 }),
        fixedLen: col.text().validate({ min: 8, max: 8 }),
        startDay: col.integer(),
        endDay: col.integer(),
        eitherWay: col.integer(),
        email: col.text(),
        payload: col.jsonb(),
        notReserved: col.text(),
        emailUnique: col.text().unique(),
        search: col.custom("tsvector"),
        computedTotal: col.numeric().readOnly(),
        createdAt: col.timestamptz().notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        constraint_shapes_child: rel.hasMany(() => constraintShapesChild, { foreignKey: "parent_id" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
